    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """
    3: S86 W2-C11 — Mellin Multiplier INFINITE-VECTOR Extension
    4: ========================================================
    5: 
    6: Gate: S86-MELLIN-MULTIPLIER-INFINITE-VECTOR-EXTENSION ([VERIFY])
    7: 
    8: Pre-registered threshold:
    9:   PASS iff max_rel_err <= 1e-12 across all 8 sample points
   10:         s in {0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0}
   11:         AND framework note exists with §1-§4 substantive content (>= 25 lines)
   12:   FAIL iff any rel_err > 1e-12 OR framework note absent / stub
   13:   NO INFO band (closed-form analytic identity).
   14: 
   15: Inputs (SHA-256 dual-pinned at runtime):
   16:   - canonical_constants.py
   17:   - script bytes
   18:   (No D_K cache; no upstream .npz; closed-form symbolic verification.)
   19: 
   20: Output 4-tuple:
   21:   (value=max_rel_err, scheme=analytic-Mellin, convention=closed-form-verification, L_max=NA)
   22: 
   23: Classification: GEOMETRIC
   24: 
   25: METHODOLOGY
   26: -----------
   27: Computes the analytic Mellin transform of the Zubarev kernel
   28: f_Z(x) = exp(-x / Lambda_Z^2) at 8 sample points s in {0.5, 1.0, ..., 4.0}
   29: via mp.quad at workdps=50, and compares against the closed-form identity
   30: M[f_Z](s) = Lambda_Z^{2s} * Gamma(s) (Erdelyi 1953; substitution u = x/Lambda_Z^2).
